updates.note: Management stated camera module capacity will expand to 180 million to 190 million annually over the next 15 to 18 months.
updates.quote: We are expanding the capacities of camera module in subsidiary Q Tech... from 70 million annually to 180 million to 190 million annually over the next 15 to 18 months

updates.note: Trial for display facility now slated for beginning of Q3 rather than Q2.
updates.quote: trial will start from the beginning of Q3 and mass production to commence from end of Q3 and beginning of Q4 this fiscal year.

updates.note: Front-loading washing machine launch and mass production shifted to Q3 FY27.
updates.quote: including fully automatic front-loading washing machine 9, which will be launched in Q3 of this fiscal.

updates.note: Telecom revenues updated to INR6,700 crores to INR7,000 crores for this fiscal.
updates.quote: we're going to be somewhere between INR6,700 crores to INR7,000 crores in this fiscal.

new_promises.statement: Smartphone volume growth expected to be 20% to 25% quarter-on-quarter for Q2.
new_promises.quote: we are expecting a 20%, 25% kind of a growth. So that is the order visibility that we are seeing
new_promises.speaker: Saurabh Gupta

new_promises.statement: Refrigerator capacity to expand from 1.5 million to 3.2 million units by Q4 of current fiscal.
new_promises.quote: expanding the capacity from 1.5 million to 3.2-odd million, which is going to be the largest capacity of refrigerators at a single site.
new_promises.speaker: Atul Lall
